lines.quote: Throughout my professional development I have built extensive expertise in embedded DSP development using both C and C++, working under real-time constraints and delivering robust, high-performance processing solutions.

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent
requirements.note: Degree field is materials science, not explicitly electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics; whether it counts as a closely adjacent field is a judgement call for the recruiter.

lines.quote: I also bring a strong foundation in Kalman filtering and estimation theory, which enables me to tackle complex state-estimation and tracking challenges with confidence.

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: Cover letter describes an aspiration to work on 'orbital platforms and high-altitude flight' as part of Kaikuvaara's work, not as the candidate's own past experience; the employer name 'Tuulenkaari Satellite Systems' is not treated as evidence per the refuse-to-guess rule.

lines.quote: I am also a proven leader. I thrive when leading cross-functional engineering teams in collaborative, high-stakes environments, and I have consistently demonstrated my ability to drive projects forward while maintaining rigorous standards of technical quality.
I have also made meaningful contributions to open-source projects, reflecting my commitment to the broader engineering community.

requirements.name: EU work authorisation
requirements.note: States nationality; Finnish citizenship entails EU work rights though the phrase 'EU work authorisation' is not used explicitly.

lines.quote: Company's working language is English; all internal documentation, reporting, and team communication conducted in English.
I am based in Oulu and ready to hit the ground running at Kaikuvaara.
